claims.statement: At n = 2^20 the fixed-base comb in proof.md recovers the BLS12-381 G1 scalar with probability 1. Group operations are the executed EFD schedules dbl-2009-l, add-2007-bl and madd-2007-bl on this curve. Every per-record cost is a product of the record count and a measured instruction delta. Total work is at most W = 6146471130971250810599119934906972741 target-group-operation equivalents. The declared score 122209170/1000000 = 122.209170 is a ceiling of log2(W) at resolution 10^(-6). Peak memory is 114494405109749170093132055902473488384 bytes. Preprocessing is 2205893093127864645514617065 reference units and is included in W. Nonuniform advice is 0 bytes.

experiments.purpose: Remeasure the limb schedule on BLS12-381 G1, rebuild W with the 7L-3 batch inversion, check full toy coverage from P0 and A_d, and print one JSON object.
